doc: Within-month cross-sectional correlation of the y1 event indicator and rs_63d. rho_hat is the average pairwise cross-sectional correlation across months. W4.2 MUST apply the Dunnett-Goldsmith effective-n correction: n_eff = n_months (DO NOT use row count n as if rows were independent). For Brier skill CIs, use month-block bootstrap (ruling A2). The formula n_eff = n / (1 + (avg_k - 1) * rho_y1) gives the number of effectively independent month-observations for Wilson CIs. High rho (>0.3) means the 30-instrument panel is dramatically less informative than its row count suggests.
